subject: Pilot procurement gating — validating monthly token spend and PO thresholds
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@orchard.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@orchard.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + pilot scope & high-level run rates

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo today. Quick follow-up while we sync internally. We ran through the pilot goals (embedding-driven search + short-form summarization for provider notes). High-level expected usage: ~30M embedding tokens/month and ~5M user-completion tokens/month initially, with 25–40% growth during the pilot.

Before we build the mutual action plan, two asks:
1) Can you confirm target $/1M token bands you typically qualify for a pilot of this size?
2) Orchard's procurement requires a PO if monthly spend exceeds $20k — is that a firm threshold for committing on Redwood Dedicated, or do you have options for committing under the PO threshold with a shorter-term pilot?

I'm attaching our boilerplate security questionnaire and a rough internal MAP. Looking for a short note on commercial/PO flexibility so we can scope the budget side to legal/procurement.

Thanks,
Liam
---
Liam O'Connor
Head of Product, Orchard Health
liam@orchard.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@orchard.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@orchard.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot scope & high-level run rates

Thanks Liam — great talking yesterday. Recap from our side and a couple of calibration questions so we can finalize a MUTUAL ACTION PLAN (MAP):

Recap / assumptions
- Pilot scope: embeddings for provider search + short summarization for notes (as discussed).
- Initial usage estimate provided: 30M embedding tokens/month, 5M completion tokens/month.
- Expected growth during the pilot: 25–40%.

Commercial calibration we need
1) Unit economics: we typically qualify pilots with a target price band. For a profile like this (embedding-heavy, steady throughput), the qualifying target we usually model is $450–$750 per 1M tokens depending on model family and quantization. Can you indicate where Orchard expects to be in that range?
2) Monthly commitment vs. procurement threshold: you mentioned PO if monthly spend > $20k. We commonly see two paths: a) short-term pilot without PO (month-to-month, usage billing) with a lower upfront commit; or b) reserved pilot commit with a PO (3-month commit) which gives improved unit economics and reserved capacity. Which path would procurement prefer?

Proposed next steps
- If PO path: we'll draft a 3-month pilot MAP that targets a committed monthly spend that maps to the 1M-token unit price needed to hit Orchard's cost objectives. I'll attach a template (Orchard_pilot_MAP_v3.xlsx) with bands so procurement can slot the PO value.
- If no PO: we can provision a hosted pilot with a soft commit and slightly higher unit rate; this typically keeps legal/procurement out of the loop but impacts unit economics.

I've attached the MAP template and our RFI summary for your legal team. If you confirm the $/1M target (or the target band) and PO threshold preference, I'll loop in Laura (billing/PO ops) and Vanessa (enterprise onboarding) to outline contract and lead times.

Talk soon —
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

Attachments: Orchard_pilot_MAP_v3.xlsx (xlsx), RFI_Security_Summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@orchard.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@orchard.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 17:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot scope & high-level run rates

Rishi —

Thanks for the clear options. A few clarifications from procurement and product:
- Token volumes: confirmed — embeddings ~30M/month, completions ~5M/month. Those are steady-state expectations for the pilot (with up to 40% spike).
- Budget/band: procurement is modeling a monthly spend window of roughly $15k–$25k depending on unit price. That maps to ~25–40% higher if we hit peak.
- Target $/1M tokens: orchard would be comfortable with guidance around $550–$650 per 1M tokens for this pilot; lower is preferred but that range is what legal/procurement will model against.
- PO rule: procurement confirmed that any single-vendor monthly spend > $20k requires a PO and additional requisition timelines (2–3 weeks). They prefer to avoid a PO for a short pilot if possible, but will issue one if the economics make the reserved path compelling.

Action for Redwood: can you (a) map the proposed unit-price bands to the MAP template showing expected monthly spend given the volumes, and (b) recommend a recommended path (soft-hosted pilot vs 3-month commit + PO) with clear lead times and the per-1M price breakpoints?

Happy to set a quick call with procurement this week if that helps.

-Liam

Laura / Vanessa —

Forwarding the Orchard thread. Summary bullets for PO & billing ops:
- Confirmed volumes: 30M embedding tokens / month + 5M completion tokens / month (pilot).
- Orchard target unit band: $550–$650 per 1M tokens for pilot modeling.
- Procurement PO threshold: $20k/month (PO required above). Procurement prefers to avoid PO for short-term pilot but will issue one if we recommend a 3-month commit that improves unit economics.

What I need from you both:
1) Laura — please map the Orchard_pilot_MAP_v3.xlsx bands to monthly spend rows using the confirmed volumes (30M / 5M) and the $/1M candidate prices (we should show $450, $550, $650, $750 breakpoints). Include a column that flags where Orchard crosses the $20k/month PO line. Attach result as po_threshold_matrix.csv so I can share with procurement.
2) Vanessa — assuming a standard 3-month committed pilot, what unit break can we offer at $/1M for these volumes (on Redwood Dedicated or Hosted reserved)? Also please indicate typical legal turnaround and onboarding lead time if PO is involved (we'll need to call out 2–3 week procurement lead time in the MAP).

Goal: send a combined MAP + matrix back to Liam by EOD Wed so Orchard procurement can slot internal approvals if they want the reserved PO path. If they choose soft-hosted pilot, we offer a month-to-month with higher unit rates but no PO/2–3 week lead time.

I'll own the comms to Liam. Let me know if you want me to open a short procurement call and I'll coordinate.

Thanks —
Rishi
